title: C DAD: no dad_retry seed loop; short_addr_dad.json and dad_hash_clarification.json have no C consumer (spec 02 4.5)
description: Reqs R-02-079, R-02-080. DIVERGENT (C only): C has bit-exact derivation primitives (lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/ipv6_addr.c:45-85, LICHEN_CRC32_INITIAL 0x4348454E in ipv6_addr.h:111) but NO dad_retry seed loop (1..=255 then None) — retry exists in rust/lichen-rpl/src/address_assignment.rs:1074-1090 and python/src/lichen/link/short_addr.py:154-171. C also consumes neither test/vectors/short_addr_dad.json nor dad_hash_clarification.json (MUST-match is satisfied by hardcoded unit tests only; bit-exactness established historically via bead project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.4.8.3). Suggested placement: dad_retry in lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/ (address assignment coordinator) and a JSON-vector consumer test like lichen/tests/rpl_sf_assignment/main.c:155 pattern.
